bio: A little out of the way, this traditional restaurant has a cosy interior, with all the charm of wood-panelled walls, old floorboards and wooden tables. Then there is the tasty cuisine, which includes flavoursome classics with a modern touch. Choose from the à la carte selection, or opt for one of the set menus (Hof Menü, Bistro Menü or vegetarian). This pleasant restaurant is popular, so be sure to book in good time! N.B. Although finding a parking space may not be easy, it's definitely worth coming....
